must_fix_applied.claim: GLM-4.7 trained on Huawei Ascend with 1.2% hallucination rate
must_fix_applied.correction: GLM-4.7 (Dec 2025) had ~90% hallucination per Vectara; the 1.2% figure was associated with the older GLM-4.5 in a single Facebook citation we couldn't independently verify. Current open-weights story is GLM-5 (Feb 2026) and GLM-5.1 (Apr 2026), both trained on ~100,000 Huawei Ascend 910B chips with MindSpore, zero NVIDIA. Manuscript rewritten to focus on the GLM-5 family and the non-NVIDIA training-stack trend, dropping the unverified hallucination claim.

must_fix_applied.claim: Musk v OpenAI verdict on Thursday, May 14, deliberated under 2 hours
must_fix_applied.correction: Verdict was Monday, May 18, 2026 (not May 14). 9-member jury deliberated ~1h 53m. Decision was on statute-of-limitations grounds (Musk filed in 2024, past the limit), not on the merits. Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers tossed the case.

May 15, 2026 is a Friday. Updated manuscript to 'Friday, May 15'. Also added concrete v0.21 features (KV offload + hybrid memory allocator, TOKENSPEED_MLA backend tuned for DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi K2.5 prefill on Blackwell) so the segment is more than just a version-bump mention.
Lushombo is at the Jesuit School of Theology at Santa Clara University, not Boston College. She is a Teresian Association consecrated woman, born in DR Congo.

hedged_or_kept.note: Approximate band — Artificial Analysis publishes a unified Intelligence Index where top open models (Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4-Pro) sit within 5-15 index points of GPT-5.5 / Opus 4.7. Specific numbers shift per refresh. Treated as 'rough band' framing.
